relations.justification: Institutions are analysed as carriers of the stratification that social structure describes.
Deviance is defined relative to institutional norms; the norms are prior to their breach.
The sociology of institutions generalises the study of schooling; education is one institution among several the same tools describe.
Labelling accounts hold that sanction produces further deviance, which contradicts the deterrent rationale punishment is justified by.
Theories of deviance specialise the general account of rule-breaking that criminal law formalises.
Social control generalises criminal sanction: punishment is one formal instrument among many informal ones.
Globalisation drives the cultural diffusion whose spatial pattern cultural geography maps.
Survey inference requires a population frame, which demography supplies; without it the sample has no defined target.
Quantitative and qualitative findings on the same question support each other when they converge, and the convergence is itself the argument for mixed method.
Claims about social structure rest on the methods that measure it, and the methods constrain what can be claimed.
Ethnographic fieldwork requires consent arrangements adequate to a setting where the researcher is present for months, which ordinary study ethics do not cover.
Market equilibrium and thermodynamic equilibrium are both stationary states reached by many interacting units under a maximisation principle, and the formal borrowing is historical.
The micro and macro views of an economy are two descriptions of one object, and the aggregation problem is the statement that they do not compose trivially.
Macroeconomics is built on aggregated microfoundations; the modern presentation begins with the optimising agent.
Environmental economics is the theory of externalities, which is a microeconomic result about missing markets.
Labour economics is applied price theory: supply, demand and elasticity in a specific market.
Open-economy macroeconomics extends the closed-economy model; the closed case is the base.
Aggregate demand conditions drive the search frictions that produce cyclical unemployment.
Macroeconomic conditions drive the wage structure through the tightness of the labour market.
Time-series methods support climate analysis; trend, seasonality and structural break are the shared apparatus.
Causal inference in economics and epidemiological confounding control are the same methodology under two vocabularies — instruments, matching and difference-in-differences appear in both.
Econometrics is statistics specialised to economic data and its identification problems.
Epidemiological study design is applied statistical inference; the identification problems are shared.
Econometric method is the tool international economics uses to make empirical claims.
Development economics is dominated by empirical identification; its central claims are econometric.
Prospect theory contradicts expected-utility maximisation as a description of choice; the reference dependence is not a refinement but a different model.
Behavioural economics derives from cognitive psychology; its findings are psychological results applied to choice.
Climate is the canonical global stock externality and a worked example of a scale-crossing system problem.
Financial statements are read against the valuation concepts financial economics supplies.
Accounting and economics share an origin in the measurement of commercial activity, though they separated early and answer different questions.
Accounting is measurement applied to economic activity, and its recognition rules are measurement conventions.
Operations management derives from manufacturing practice and generalises its flow concepts to services.
Comparative government evaluates arrangements against the values political theory articulates.
International relations theory is political theory under anarchy; the domestic case is the contrast that defines it.
Electoral analysis presupposes the institutional forms comparative government classifies.
Electoral systems are apportionment mathematics; the seat-allocation methods are arithmetic results with known paradoxes.
Public opinion measurement depends on survey methodology, and its failures are sampling failures.
Realist accounts treat relative gains as decisive while trade theory treats absolute gains as sufficient motivation; the two predict different cooperation outcomes.
Realist accounts of international politics and democratic-peace claims disagree about whether regime type constrains state behaviour.
Policy evaluation is causal inference; the credibility of an evaluation is the credibility of its identification strategy.
A policy evaluation requires an identification strategy; without one the before-and-after comparison is not evidence.
Natural-law and positivist accounts of validity give incompatible answers to whether an unjust rule is law; the disagreement is the field's organising axis.
How a system ranks its sources is what places it in a legal family; the taxonomy is a taxonomy of source hierarchies.
Comparative law presupposes the concepts — source, validity, interpretation — that jurisprudence supplies.
Procedure implements a theory of what adjudication is for; the jurisprudential account comes first even when it is left implicit.
The law of obligations as taught is the civil-law systematisation; its categories are a tradition's and not universal.
Legal families and language families are both genealogical classifications built from shared descent and borrowing, with the same difficulty distinguishing the two.
Human rights obligations are treaty obligations; the law of treaties governs their formation, reservation and denunciation.
International humanitarian law is treaty law with customary reinforcement; the sources doctrine is prior.
Customary international law and treaty law are distinguished by how consent is expressed, and the codification conventions turned much custom into treaty.
Public international law establishes the state system within which conflict-of-laws rules allocate authority between its members.
Conflict of laws is procedural law extended to cases with a foreign element.
Judicial review is the mechanism by which constitutional rights acquire operative content; without it the guarantee is declaratory.
Social rights are constitutional claims before they are statutory entitlements, and the constitutional framing sets what legislation may not remove.
Administrative law operates inside the constitutional allocation of power; the limits on an agency are constitutional before they are administrative.
Public procurement and state aid control are the two disciplines on public money in a market, and they interact at every subsidy-bearing contract.
The general part supplies the liability elements every specific offence is built from; the special part is unreadable without it.
Procedure is organised around proving the elements the special part defines.
Economic crime is the reason assurance exists in its present form; each major fraud has produced a regulatory response in audit.
The CISG is a contract regime; general contract doctrine is what it varies.
Consumer protection displaces contract terms; the default rules must be known before the mandatory ones can be seen as displacing them.
Transfer of property is effected by obligations; the contract is the vehicle and the conveyance is its performance.
Commercial law is the law of obligations applied to enterprise; contract is its substrate.
The employment relationship is a contract before mandatory law modifies it, and the modifications are unintelligible without the baseline.
A security interest is a right over property; ownership and possession are prior to encumbrance.
Insolvency ranking is the priority of security interests realised under scarcity.
Insolvency distribution operates on the priority that security interests establish; the ranking is a property-law fact before it is an insolvency one.
Securities regulation depends on the asset-pricing account of what disclosure is for and what informed prices do.
Securities disclosure obligations attach to entities whose governance defines who is responsible for the statement.
Commercial law specialises the general law of obligations to transactions between enterprises.
Corporate taxation is levied on entities whose forms and accounts company law defines.
Competition law regulates undertakings; what counts as one is a company-law question first.
Employment protection presupposes a social-security system to carry the risk that dismissal transfers; without it the protection is either nominal or absolute.
Occupational safety duties are stated as exposure limits, which occupational health measurement supplies.
Pension system design depends on demographic projection; the sustainability question is a dependency-ratio question.
Originality in copyright is judged against what already exists, which is the intertextual question literary study asks in another register.
A patent grant is conditional on disclosure sufficient for a skilled reader to reproduce the invention; the claims define the right only against a description that enables it.
IP licensing requires the competition limits on restrictive terms; an exclusive licence can be an unlawful agreement.
Intellectual property is a principal asset class of the modern enterprise, and licensing structures presuppose the corporate forms that hold it.
Transfer pricing adjustment operates inside the allocation of taxing rights that treaties establish; without the treaty framework there is no counterparty adjustment.
Tax compliance rests on records an audit can test; without an assurance layer, self-assessment has no verification path.
Tax law is administrative law applied to revenue: assessment, appeal and enforcement follow the general pattern.
Cartel behaviour exemplifies the repeated prisoner's dilemma, and the leniency instrument is designed against that structure.
Merger control operates on the same theory of harm as the agreements prohibition — it asks whether a structure will produce the coordination that conduct rules forbid.
Private damages actions require quantification of harm, which is an econometric exercise the court must be given.
Competition law is applied microeconomics: market definition, dominance and consumer harm are economic constructs the law adopts wholesale.
Data-subject rights are exercised against processing that the principles make lawful; the principles come first.
A lawful cross-border transfer presupposes a lawful processing basis; adequacy and safeguards address the destination, not the ground.
Incident reporting obligations presuppose the integrity checks that detect a breach at all.
Electronic signature law and asymmetric cryptography are the legal and technical faces of one mechanism.
Data protection is regulatory administrative law with an independent supervisory authority.
Impact assessment requires a hazard and exposure baseline; without the spatial distribution of risk the assessment has no reference.
Environmental law is administrative law with a specific protected interest; its instruments are permits and inspections.
Evidence rules operate inside a procedural frame that determines when and by whom proof is offered.
Legal standards of proof and scientific confirmation are both graded thresholds on evidence, and both distinguish the burden from the standard.
An arbitral award is worth what its enforcement is worth; the New York framework is what makes consensual adjudication commercially usable.
Climate is the primary control on ecosystem distribution; the biome map is a climate map with a lag.
Environmental geography reasons about human impact on physical systems that physical geography describes.
City-size distributions follow the same power law as many other complex systems, and the rank-size regularity is the standard example.
Economic geography is economics with location as an explicit variable.
Boundary disputes exemplify state responsibility and its dispute-settlement machinery.
Map projection is dimensional reasoning made visible: every projection trades one invariant for another and none preserves all.
Remote sensing superseded field survey as the primary source for thematic mapping at regional scale, without replacing it for ground truth.
A geographic information system is a spatially indexed database; its query model is the database's.
A GIS requires a coordinate reference; layers in different datums do not overlay and the error is silent.
Spatial statistics derives from general statistics with an added dependence structure that ordinary methods violate.
Regional synthesis is presented cartographically; the representation methods precede the synthesis.
Land-use change is the proximate cause of most persistent anthropogenic landscape transformation.
Environmental geography treats a coupled human-natural system, which is the systems vocabulary applied spatially.
Demography depends on census and survey infrastructure; its measures are only as good as the enumeration behind them.
Excavation requires a heritage framework, because the act destroys the context it recovers and is therefore irreversible.
Stratigraphic dating and radiometric dating are relative and absolute chronologies of the same deposit, and their disagreement is diagnostic.
Absolute archaeological chronology rests on radiochemistry — radiocarbon and related decay clocks are chemistry applied to dating.
Archaeological science rests on nuclear physics: radiometric dating is decay measurement.
